svg.aria-label: Rim, a hermit crab, carries on its back a square frame of 4 by 4 cells: the 4 inner cells are blue and the ring of 12 cells around them is amber, with the 4 corner cells grey. Behind it lies the sandy grid of a heated plate, with the same 4 by 4 square marked out where Rim lifted it. A tag says load the tile and its halo once.
